tasks.CompareValues: Comparing the values obtained from evaluating the function at critical points and boundaries to find the maximum value.
tasks.EvaluateFunctionAtBoundary: Evaluating the function at the boundary conditions for x and y.
tasks.FindCriticalPoints: Finding the critical points of the function f(x,y) = x * sqrt(1 - y^2) + y * sqrt(1 - x^2).
